mentions.name: Tech Posts
mentions.description: A Hacker News-style community news site for Europe, where users share and discuss tech stories. It features a growing jobs section positioned as a high signal-to-noise source for European tech jobs, and aims to surface European tech innovation—such as space launch, battery, and AI companies—that often goes unnoticed.
mentions.problem: Much of the incredible innovation and growth in Europe flies under the radar, with Europe often perceived as stagnant ("banks and museums").
mentions.audience: Europeans in tech, including people looking for European tech jobs
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Tech Posts (https://techposts.eu), a Hacker News for Europe!

Since the last time I posted on HN it's gained a decent amount of traffic and users. I'm particularly happy with the jobs section, which is growing into a high signal-noise source for European tech jobs: https://techposts.eu/jobs
